label_definition: label 1 = failed or errored, 0 = passed; canceled/started excluded (ADR-0005)

feature_coverage.drop_rule: features null for every training row are removed from all model inputs

time_features.rule: keep time features only if validation PR-AUC improves

selection.rule: highest validation PR-AUC among eligible candidates

validation.threshold_rule: raw-score threshold maximising F1 on validation

cold_start_no_history_model.note: same family + hyper-parameters, trained without history features

calibration.selected_on: validation (5-fold CV Brier inside the validation split)

test.reference_note: computed in the same single test pass, after the final model was locked on validation; never used for selection

bands.rule: band = highest level whose raw-score cut the score reaches (score >= cut)
